{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下眼眠為淚堂，宜豐满，不欲深䧟，眶中肉虚若腫，曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蠧肉不宜横生，鼻尖為凖，宜齐大，不欲尖小下唇上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形如破竹而仰者，曰人中，又名溝洫，宜深長，不欲平。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"满盖淚堂，為男方子孫之宫，準與人中，乃宫室奴僕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之位，若有此破陷，主儿孫之刑克也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼不哭而淚汪汪，心無憂而","logicSentenceId":"7679057187129638964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉縮縮。","logicSentenceId":"7679057187129638964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"早無刑尅，□□孤单。","logicSentenceId":"7679057187129655348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神色如桃花，嬌嫩，邪淫之人也，恐生子不早矣。鬼谷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云：桃花色重仍远花宠外妻信侵乎。目子恋必脱酒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻梁乃年夀之位，不宜低凹，有若此者，必傷財壽，非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貧則夭。古云：山根斷准頭高，徹老受波滔。正謂此他。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三停，觧見前。廣記云：中停長近公王，上停長幼善祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下停長老吉昌，三停俱等富貴綿。上若下停，偏長末。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雖富貴，未免晚年勞碌也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星辰失陷，部位偏虧，無隔宿","logicSentenceId":"7679057187129770036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之儲，有終身之劳。","logicSentenceId":"7679057187129770036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7679057187129786420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如眼為日月而不明，鼻為土星而不隆，此星辰之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失","logicSentenceId":"7679057187129802804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"䧟也。餘皆仿此。額位乎天，宜高而反低；颏位乎地，宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"厚而反薄，此部位之偏𧇊也。餘亦准此。相有如此，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貧賤之人矣，終身勞苦，而无隔宿之粮也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
